title: Native Higher-Call Secret-Subspace Restriction Audit: Projected Variety Pinching, Coset Harmonic Folding, and Fourier-Space Law of Total Variance

theorems.name: Exact Projected Collision-Variety Pinching on W_S
theorems.statement: For any r-dimensional secret subspace W_S = colspan(G_S) in F_q^n, averaging P_(epsilon, sigma)(x | s) over s ~ Unif(W_S) pinches the double trajectory sum onto V_epsilon(f; W_S) = {(w, w') : tau_epsilon(w) - tau_epsilon(w') in W_S^perp} and equals sum_(delta in W_S^perp) C_(epsilon, sigma)(delta; x).

theorems.name: Exact Folded Parseval Identity for Within-Subspace Secret Variance
theorems.statement: With folded harmonics C^(W_S)(delta_bar; x) = sum_(G_S^T delta == delta_bar mod q) C(delta; x), the within-subspace secret variance Var_(s ~ W_S)[P(x | s)] equals sum_(delta_bar in F_q^r \ {0}) |C^(W_S)(delta_bar; x)|^2.

theorems.name: Disjoint Harmonic Partition of Between-Coset and Within-Coset Variance Across F_q^n / W_S
theorems.statement: Across the q^(n-r) cosets W_S + a in F_q^n / W_S, the between-coset variance Var_a[E_(s ~ W_S+a)[P(x | s)]] equals sum_(delta in W_S^perp \ {0}) |C(delta; x)|^2 and the expected within-coset variance E_a[Var_(s ~ W_S+a)[P(x | s)]] equals sum_(delta not in W_S^perp) |C(delta; x)|^2, summing to Var_(s ~ F_q^n)[P(x | s)].
